title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 03/2016
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, mics set-up on the SBD platform, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience recording of an exceptional 9/17/82 show with rock‑solid performance and crystal‑clear sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the 9/17/82 Cumberland concert, calling it “rock solid” and highlighting standout performances of Bertha, High Time, Touch of Grey and the GDTRFB > Morning Dew sequence. The audience recording is praised for its vivid presence and “off‑the‑charts” sound quality, making the show feel transportive and immediate.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are five‑star, emphasize an exceptional performance and an excellent audience recording with no noted flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as “off the charts” and note that the audience capture puts listeners right in the venue, indicating superb clarity and presence.

standout_songs: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad > Morning Dew
show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently strong from start to finish; the set flows smoothly with high‑energy peaks and memorable transitions.
